references.text: Joshua conquered Debir and struck down its king, as mentioned in the list of defeated kings in chapter 12.
Debir is mentioned again when Othniel captures the city and takes Caleb's daughter Achsah as his wife.
Geder is listed as one of the cities in the lowland assigned to the tribe of Judah.
The conquest of Debir is retold in Judges, where Othniel takes the city.
Gedor (a name similar to Geder) is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Simeon in 1 Chronicles.
